findings.title: Failed coverage authority is not enforced by machine timing gates
findings.novelty: New machine-policy propagation defect; failed population coverage is already acknowledged and is not rediscovered.
findings.observed: The valid synthetic one-case six-session receipt and the published warm Chebyshev receipt both return Ok(Promote). The source consumer maps Promote directly to WallCriterion::Passed.
findings.expected: A diagnostic numeric decision may be retained, but the documented STATISTICAL_AUTHORITY_HOLD must yield NotEvaluated for a scientific/production timing gate.
findings.scope_limit: The library path and published receipt replay were executed. CLI mapping was read; a full fresh CLI performance campaign was not executed. No corruption or overclaim by the prior author is alleged: prose correctly discloses the hold.

findings.title: Malformed later session cells pass full receipt recomputation
findings.novelty: New per-session admission gap after the original R3 raw-case defect was closed.
findings.observed: Empty/one later-session warmup and 29/31 samples across adjacent sessions pass as Ok(Promote). A reversed timestamp also passes. Candidate/reference flattened arrays can be identical despite invalid cell lengths.
findings.expected: Every raw session cell must be complete before merging, with the required warmups and sample count, valid labels/order and first-session-calibrated batch identity.
findings.cause: Only first-session warmups survive merging. Per-record loop checks labels/order and warmup value finiteness but omits warmup count and candidate/reference lengths. Global total-length validation cannot detect the 29/31 redistribution.
findings.scope_limit: Synthetic malformed-record construction and current public verifier were executed; genuine recorded campaign corruption was not observed. Unauthenticated JSON provenance is a separately acknowledged limitation and is not the finding.

prior_closure.evidence: Five original malformed-case mutations rejected in this native probe; runtime r3_raw_protocol_admission_contracts 3 tests pass.

Fixed-B Hoeffding MC gate is implemented, original two contracts pass. It does not establish population coverage.
